Cérémonies académiques 2026 : Ooredoo Al: Academic ceremonies 2026: Ooredoo Algeria strengthens its educational partnership
Ooredoo Algérie a confirmé son rôle acti: Ooredoo Algeria confirmed its active role in the national educational landscape by deploying a notable presence during the graduation ceremonies of the 2026 promotions of four establishments of excellence. The operator thus provided its support to the National School of Computer Science (ESI), the National School of Journalism and Information Sciences (ENSJSI), the School of Advanced Commercial Studies (EHEC) and the Houari Boumediene University of Science and Technology (USTHB).
Ces participations s'inscrivent dans la: These participations are a continuation of the actions undertaken by Ooredoo Algeria in favor of the training of the country's future talents. The ceremonies, marked by the awarding of diplomas to the winners, were an opportunity for the operator to reaffirm its commitment to Algerian academic institutions.

Ooredoo Algérie a joint à son communiqué: Ooredoo Algeria attached to its press release a selection of images capturing the highlights of the graduation ceremonies of the 2026 promotions. These visual documents are made available to the media for wider distribution, thus strengthening the visibility of the events and establishments concerned.
Cette initiative s'ajoute aux multiples: This initiative is in addition to the multiple actions carried out by Ooredoo Algeria to support the Algerian education sector. The operator, a major player in telecommunications in the country, is increasing partnerships with academic institutions to support the professional integration of young graduates and promote technological innovation.
